title: Diagram Roadmap project configuration
description: Strict YAML-compatible data model for roadmap-config.yml. YAML null and empty scalar values fall through during precedence resolution.

path.description: Project-relative roadmap file. Empty or null falls through; a non-empty value is validated for canonical project containment.

dir.description: Project-relative ADR directory. Empty or null falls through; a non-empty value is validated for canonical project containment.

globs.description: Ordered project-bounded patterns. An explicit empty list is valid and replaces lower-precedence lists.

max_findings.description: Maximum findings count. Zero is valid; YAML booleans are rejected by runtime exact-type validation.

x-yaml-validation: Reject duplicate keys, aliases, merge keys, unsafe tags, multiple documents, malformed input, and inputs larger than the documented bound before applying this structure.
x-unknown-keys: Unknown top-level or nested keys are errors and produce no configuration output.
